title: Ravana re-approached the battle-field
introduction: Ravana reproached the charioteer for having turned back his chariot away from the battle-field. The charioteer explains to Ravana, the various reasons as to why he has taken back the chariot. Satisfied with the explanation given by his charioteer, Ravana instructs him to take the chariot back to the battle-field. Thereupon, the charioteer brings the chariot in an instant before Rama on the battle-field.
closing: इत्यर्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे चतुरधिकशततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 104th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
स तु मोहात्सुसङ्क्रुद्धः कृतान्तबलचोदितः |
क्रोधसन्रक्तनयनो रावणो सूतमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa tu mohAtsusañkruddhaḥ kṛtAntabalacoditaḥ |
krodhasanraktanayano rAvaṇo sUtamabravIt
verses.translation: Impelled by force of Destiny and with his red-blood eyes through anger due to infatuation, that Ravana spoke to his charioteer as follows:

glosses.meaning: with his red-blood eyes through anger

verses.devanagari:
हीनवीर्यमिवाशक्तं पौरुषेण विवर्जितम् |
भीरुन् लघुमिवासत्त्वं विहीनमिव तेजसा
विमुक्तमिव मायाभिरस्त्रैरिव बहिष्कृतम् |
मामवज्ञाय दुर्बुद्धे स्वया बुद्ध्या विचेष्टसे
verses.iast:
hInavIryamivAśaktaṃ pauruṣeṇa vivarjitam |
bhIrun laghumivAsattvaṃ vihInamiva tejasA
vimuktamiva mAyAbhirastrairiva bahiṣkṛtam |
mAmavaGYAya durbuddhe svayA buddhyA viceṣṭase
verses.translation: "O evil-minded fellow! Despising me as though I were bereft of manliness, incapable, deficient in prowess, cowardly, petty-minded, devoid of energy, bereft of brilliance, deserted of conjuring tricks and abandoned by mystic missiles, you are acting as per your discretion!"

verses.devanagari:
किमर्थं मामवज्ञाय मच्छन्दमनवेक्ष्य च |
त्वया शत्रुसमक्षं मे रथोअयमपवाहितः
verses.iast:
kimarthaṃ mAmavaGYAya macchandamanavekṣya ca |
tvayA śatrusamakṣaṃ me rathoayamapavAhitaḥ
verses.translation: "Why have you carried away this chariot of mine, thus humiliating me in the presence of my enemies and overlooking my will?"

verses.devanagari:
त्वयाद्य हि ममानार्य चिरकालसमार्जितम् |
यशो वीर्यन् च तेजश्च प्रत्ययश्च विनाशिथ
verses.iast:
tvayAdya hi mamAnArya cirakAlasamArjitam |
yaśo vIryan ca tejaśca pratyayaśca vinAśitha
verses.translation: "O vulgar fellow! You have destroyed my fame which was earned through a long period, prowess, vital power and the trust of people today."

glosses.meaning: which was earned through a long period

verses.devanagari:
शत्रोः प्रख्यातवीर्यस्य रञ्जनीयस्य विक्रमैः |
पश्यतो युद्धलुब्धोअहन् कृतः कापुरुषस्त्वया
verses.iast:
śatroḥ prakhyAtavIryasya rañjanIyasya vikramaiḥ |
paśyato yuddhalubdhoahan kṛtaḥ kApuruṣastvayA
verses.translation: "While my adversary, having an illustrious prowess and making others delightful through feats of his valour, stood looking on, myself, who has an ardent desire for fighting and who was made contemptible by you!"

glosses.meaning: having an ardent desire for battle

verses.devanagari:
यस्त्वन् रथमिमं मोहान्न चोद्वहसि दुर्मते |
सत्योअयं प्रतितर्को मे परेण त्वमुपस्कृतः
verses.iast:
yastvan rathamimaṃ mohAnna codvahasi durmate |
satyoayaṃ pratitarko me pareṇa tvamupaskṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "O evil-minded fellow! In case you do not, by perversity, carry away this chariot at any event, this expectation of mine that you stand corrupted by the enemy, will be a fact."

verses.devanagari:
न हीदन् विद्यते कर्म सुहृदो हितकाङ्क्षिणः |
रिपूणान् सदृशन् चैतन्न त्वयैतत्स्वनुष्ठितम्
verses.iast:
na hIdan vidyate karma suhṛdo hitakAñkṣiṇaḥ |
ripUṇAn sadṛśan caitanna tvayaitatsvanuṣṭhitam
verses.translation: "This act, which has been done by you, is only befitting of enemies. This is indeed not the work of a friend, who wishes me well."

verses.devanagari:
निवर्तय रथन् शीघ्रं यावन्नापैति मे रिपुः |
यदि वाप्युषितोअसि त्वन् स्मर्यन्ते यदि वा गुणाः
verses.iast:
nivartaya rathan śIghraṃ yAvannApaiti me ripuḥ |
yadi vApyuṣitoasi tvan smaryante yadi vA guṇAḥ
verses.translation: "If you inhabited with me in Lanka for a long time and if you remember my merit, drive back the chariot swiftly till my enemy does not withdraw."

glosses.meaning: inhabited with me for a long time

verses.devanagari:
एवं परुषमुक्तस्तु हितबुद्धिरबुद्धिना |
अब्रवीद्रावणन् सूतो हितं सानुनयं वचः
verses.iast:
evaṃ paruṣamuktastu hitabuddhirabuddhinA |
abravIdrAvaṇan sUto hitaṃ sAnunayaṃ vacaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing those harsh words of the foolish Ravana, the friendly-minded charioteer spoke the following conciliatory words of Ravana:

verses.devanagari:
न भीतोअस्मि न मूढोअस्मि नोपजप्तोअस्मि शत्रुभिः |
न प्रमत्तो न निःस्नेहो विस्मृता न च सत्क्रिया
verses.iast:
na bhItoasmi na mUḍhoasmi nopajaptoasmi śatrubhiḥ |
na pramatto na niḥsneho vismṛtA na ca satkriyA
verses.translation: "I was neither frightened nor I was stupid. I was not bribed by the enemies, nor was I a blunderer. I was not disloyal to you. I have not forgotten the benefits conferred by you."

verses.devanagari:
मया तु हितकामेन यशश्च परिरक्षता |
स्नेहप्रस्कन्नमनसा प्रियमित्यप्रियन् कृतम्
verses.iast:
mayA tu hitakAmena yaśaśca parirakṣatA |
snehapraskannamanasA priyamityapriyan kṛtam
verses.translation: "An act which was not to your taste was done by me as something conducive to your interest, by wishing well of you, for protecting your honour and with mind affectionately disposed towards you through attachment."

glosses.meaning: with a mind affectionately disposed towards you through attachment
an act which was not to your liking
as something conducive to your interest.

verses.devanagari:
नास्मिन्नर्थे महाराज त्वं मां प्रियहिते रतम् |
कश्चिल्लघुरिवानार्यो दोषतो गन्तुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
nAsminnarthe mahArAja tvaṃ mAṃ priyahite ratam |
kaścillaghurivAnAryo doṣato gantumarhasi
verses.translation: "O monarch! Like somebody who is petty-minded and unworthy, you ought not to hold me, devoted as I am to your pleasure and good, quilty in this matter."

glosses.meaning: like somebody who is petty-minded and unworthy
devoted as I am to your pleasure and good

verses.devanagari:
श्रूयतामभिधास्यामि यन्निमित्तं मया रथः |
नदीवेग इवाम्भोभिः सन्युगे विनिवर्तितः
verses.iast:
śrUyatAmabhidhAsyAmi yannimittaṃ mayA rathaḥ |
nadIvega ivAmbhobhiḥ sanyuge vinivartitaḥ
verses.translation: "O monarch! Like somebody who is petty-minded and unworthy, you ought not to hold me, devoted as I am to your pleasure and good, guilty in this matter."

glosses.meaning: like somebody who is petty-minded and unworthy
devoted as I am to your pleasure and good

verses.devanagari:
श्रमन् तवावगच्छामि महता रणकर्मणा |
न हि ते वीर सौमुख्यं प्रहर्षन् वोपधारये
verses.iast:
śraman tavAvagacchAmi mahatA raṇakarmaṇA |
na hi te vIra saumukhyaṃ praharṣan vopadhAraye
verses.translation: "I understand your exhaustion, due to your strenuous fighting in the great battle. I am not reflecting on the inclination of your valour or on your superiority over your enemy."

glosses.meaning: as the onrush of a stream

verses.devanagari:
रथोद्वहनखिन्नाश्च त इमे रथवाजिनः |
दीना घर्मपरिश्रान्ता गावो वर्षहता इव
verses.iast:
rathodvahanakhinnAśca ta ime rathavAjinaḥ |
dInA gharmapariśrAntA gAvo varṣahatA iva
verses.translation: "The horses of my chariot were broken down and were exhausted by drawing the chariot. They became miserable and thoroughly fatigued, like the cows lashed by heavy rain."

glosses.meaning: and were exhausted by drawing the chariot

verses.devanagari:
निमित्तानि च भूयिष्ठन् यानि प्रादुर्भवन्ति नः |
तेषु तेष्वभिपन्नेषु लक्षयाम्यप्रदक्षिणम्
verses.iast:
nimittAni ca bhUyiṣṭhan yAni prAdurbhavanti naḥ |
teṣu teṣvabhipanneṣu lakṣayAmyapradakṣiṇam
verses.translation: "I am seeing inauspiciousness in all the portents, which appear to us in large numbers and duly examined by me."

verses.devanagari:
देशकालौ च विज्ञेयौ लक्ष्मणानीङ्गितानि च |
दैन्यन् हर्षश्च खेदश्च रथिनश्च बलाबलम्
verses.iast:
deśakAlau ca viGYeyau lakṣmaṇAnIñgitAni ca |
dainyan harṣaśca khedaśca rathinaśca balAbalam
verses.translation: "(Propitious and unpropitious) time and place, (good and bad) omens, facial as also the strength and weakness of the warrior occupying the chariot must be ascertained (by a charioteer)."

glosses.meaning: of the warrior occupying the chariot

verses.devanagari:
स्थलनिम्नानि भूमेश्च समानि विषमाणि च |
युद्धकालश्च विज्ञेयः परस्यान्तरदर्शनम्
verses.iast:
sthalanimnAni bhUmeśca samAni viṣamAṇi ca |
yuddhakAlaśca viGYeyaḥ parasyAntaradarśanam
verses.translation: "The eminences and depressions of the ground as well as the parts which are level and rugged, the time appropriate for the combat and the visible weak points of the enemy must be known (by a charioteer)."

glosses.meaning: as well as the parts which are level and rugged
the time appropriate for the combat

verses.devanagari:
उपयानापयाने च स्थानं प्रत्यपसर्पणम् |
सर्वमेतद्रथस्थेन ज्ञेयन् रथकुटुम्बिना
verses.iast:
upayAnApayAne ca sthAnaṃ pratyapasarpaṇam |
sarvametadrathasthena GYeyan rathakuṭumbinA
verses.translation: "How to arrive and retreat, how to hold one's position and to recede all this must be known by a charioteer, seated in the chariot."

glosses.meaning: how to hold one's position and how to recede

verses.devanagari:
तव विश्रामहेतोस्तु तथैषान् रथवाजिनाम् |
रौद्रन् वर्जयता खेदन् क्षमं कृतमिदं मया
verses.iast:
tava viśrAmahetostu tathaiṣAn rathavAjinAm |
raudran varjayatA khedan kṣamaṃ kṛtamidaṃ mayA
verses.translation: "This action appropriate was taken by me in order to give rest to you and to these horses of the chariot as also to relieve your terrible fatigue."

glosses.meaning: in order to give rest to you
to these horses of the chariot

verses.devanagari:
न मया स्वेच्छया वीर रथोअयमपवाहितः |
भर्तृस्नेहपरीतेन मयेदन् यत्कृतं विभो
verses.iast:
na mayA svecchayA vIra rathoayamapavAhitaḥ |
bhartṛsnehaparItena mayedan yatkṛtaṃ vibho
verses.translation: "O the valiant lord! This chariot was not removed by me arbitrarily. That which was done by me was because I was overwhelmed with affection for my master."

glosses.meaning: because I was overwhelmed with affection for my master.

verses.devanagari:
आज्ञापय यथातत्त्वन् वक्ष्यस्यरिनिषूदन |
तत्करिष्याम्यहन् वीरन् गतानृण्येन चेतसा
verses.iast:
AGYApaya yathAtattvan vakṣyasyariniṣUdana |
tatkariṣyAmyahan vIran gatAnṛṇyena cetasA
verses.translation: "O annihilator of enemies! O hero! Give me a command! I will do that which you will enjoin me to do, with due attention and with a mind which feels relieved of all that is due."

glosses.meaning: with a mind which feels relieved of all that is due.

verses.devanagari:
सन्तुष्टस्तेन वाक्येन रावणस्तस्य सारथेः |
प्रशस्यैनं बहुविधन् युद्धलुब्धोअब्रवीदिदम्
verses.iast:
santuṣṭastena vAkyena rAvaṇastasya sAratheḥ |
praśasyainaṃ bahuvidhan yuddhalubdhoabravIdidam
verses.translation: Satisfied with the explanation given by his charioteer and applauding him in many ways, Ravana who was avaricious of fighting, spoke the following words:

verses.devanagari:
रथन् शीघ्रमिमं सूत राघवाभिमुखन् कुरु |
नाहत्वा समरे शत्रून्निवर्तिष्यति रावणः
verses.iast:
rathan śIghramimaṃ sUta rAghavAbhimukhan kuru |
nAhatvA samare śatrUnnivartiṣyati rAvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "O charioteer! Take this chariot quickly towards Rama. Ravana does not turn back in battle, without killing his enemies."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा ततस्तुष्टो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः |
ददौ तस्य शुभन् ह्येकं हस्ताभरणमुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
evamuktvA tatastuṣṭo rAvaṇo rAkṣaseśvaraḥ |
dadau tasya śubhan hyekaṃ hastAbharaṇamuttamam
verses.translation: Thus speaking Ravna the lord of demons was pleased and then presented a beautiful and excellent ornament for the hand to him. That charioteer, after hearing Ravana's instruction,s drove the chariot back to the battle-field.

glosses.meaning: drove the chariot back to the battle-field.

verses.devanagari:
ततो द्रुतन् रावणवाक्यचोदितः |
प्रचोदयामास हयान्स सारथिः |
स राक्षसेन्द्रस्य ततो महारथः |
क्षणेन रामस्य रणाग्रतोअभवत्
verses.iast:
tato drutan rAvaṇavAkyacoditaḥ |
pracodayAmAsa hayAnsa sArathiḥ |
sa rAkṣasendrasya tato mahArathaḥ |
kṣaṇena rAmasya raṇAgratoabhavat
verses.translation: Impelled by Ravana's command, that charioteer thereupon quickly drove the horses forward. Then, that chariot of Ravana stood within a moment, before Rama's chariot on the battle-field.
